headline: Jubo Dal leader hacked to death in broad daylight in Jashore
summary: Rubel Hossain, joint general secretary of the Bandabila union unit Jubo Dal, was killed in Bagharpara upazila today.
details: Rubel Hossain, a 38-year-old Jubo Dal leader, was hacked to death in broad daylight in Bagharpara upazila of Jashore today.
The attack occurred around 11:30 am in front of the Khajura Filling Station. Rubel served as the joint general secretary of the Bandabila union unit Jubo Dal.
According to police and local sources, a man identified as Rabbi attacked Rubel repeatedly with a sharp weapon before fleeing the scene.
Locals rushed the critically injured Rubel to Jashore General Hospital, where the on-duty physician declared him dead.
Jashore district Jubo Dal President M Tamal Hossain has demanded a thorough investigation and exemplary punishment for the perpetrators.
Bagharpara Police Station OC Shah Jalal Alam stated that multiple police teams are currently conducting drives to arrest the prime suspect, Rabbi.

headline: 327 hospitalised as two more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The total number of dengue-related deaths this year has risen to 27, with 823 patients currently undergoing treatment across the country.
details: At least two dengue patients died and 327 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), one death was reported in Dhaka South City Corporation and another in the Chattogram division.
The total number of dengue-related deaths this year has now reached 27, while the total number of cases has climbed to 8,650.
Currently, 823 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across Bangladesh.
